name: Ephesus
overview: The Scriptures reveal Ephesus as a significant center of early Christian ministry, where Paul visited and reasoned with the Jews in the synagogue, although he did not stay long during his initial visit, intending to return if God willed. His time there was part of a broader mission to strengthen disciples throughout the region. Ephesus also served as a strategic location for sending ministry workers like Tychicus and for Timothy to remain as directed by Paul, underscoring its importance in the early church's growth and pastoral care.
